abstract: Nature Communications, Published online: 29 October 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-79281-3 Magnons in quantum Hall ferromagnets can be used as a very sensitive probe of magnetic order. Thus far, this technique has only been applied to single material systems. Here, Lee et al extend this to a heterostructure, using magnons generated in a monolayer of graphene to detect spin order in bilayer graphene.

title: A Drude-Augmented Kramers–Kronig Framework for Predicting Optical Properties of Substitutionally Doped Low-Dimensional Semiconductors: Application to (8,0) SiC Nanotubes
title_zh: 文献研究：A Drude-Augmented Kramers–Kronig Framework for Predicting Optical Properties of Substitutionally Doped Low-Dimensional Semiconductors: Application to (8,0) SiC Nanotubes
summary: We present a generalizable computational framework that combines a Kramers--Kronig transformation with a Drude free-carrier term to predict the optical and dielectric properties of substitutionally do…
abstract: We present a generalizable computational framework that combines a Kramers--Kronig transformation with a Drude free-carrier term to predict the optical and dielectric properties of substitutionally doped low-dimensional semiconductors. The framework is designed as a fast-screening alternative to full density functional theory (DFT) calculations, requiring only three physically transparent input parameters: the effective bandgap energy, the peak absorption energy, and the static dielectric constant. For metallic dopants, a Drude term is added with plasma frequency and scattering rate taken from optical fits of post-transition metals. The framework is validated against published first-principles DFT results for Al-, N-, and P-doped SiC nanotubes and against spectroscopic ellipsometry data for bulk 3C-SiC and 4H-SiC, showing good quantitative agreement. As a demonstration, we apply the framework to 15 dopant configurations of the pristine zigzag (8,0) silicon carbide nanotube (SiCNT), covering Group~III (B, Al, Ga, In, Tl), Group~V (N, P, As, Sb, Bi), and Group~VII (F, Cl, Br, I) elements. The framework captures the p-type to plasmonic transition in the Group~III series (absorption onset shifts from 2.0~eV to 1.0~eV), the monotonic bandgap narrowing in the Group~V series (sim3.7~eV for N to sim1.2~eV for Bi), and the systematic redshift in the halogen series (1.85~eV for pristine to 1.43 ± 0.20~eV for Cl). The framework provides a reproducible, computationally inexpensive route to optical property prediction for doped low-dimensional systems and yields quantitative guidelines for UV photodetectors, visible-range photocatalysts, infrared sensors, and broadband plasmonic devices. Complete Python source code, material parameter database, and figure generation scripts are provided for full reproducibility.

title: Assessing the Robustness of European and Chinese Air and High Speed Rail Network Accessibility
title_zh: 评估欧洲和中国空中和高速铁路网络可达性的稳健性
summary: 航空和高速铁路（ HSR ）是大陆长途旅行的主要模式。虽然它们的集成可以显着增强系统稳健性，但Air和HSR网络之间的网络拓扑和治理模型在各个地区之间存在巨大差异。我们对照欧洲和中国的综合航空高铁网络，对纯航空网络进行定量、比较稳健性分析。使用调度服务的多层网络表示、拓扑度量和基于调度的路由算法，网络将受到模拟随机机场故障、自适应定向枢纽攻击和航空公司运营关闭的影响。结果表明，在随机故障下，两个单峰航空网络都表现出相似的拓扑衰减。
abstract: Aviation and High-speed rail (HSR) are primary modes for continental long-distance travel. While their integration can significantly enhance systemic robustness, network topologies and governance models differ drastically between Air and HSR networks across regions. We conduct a quantitative, comparative robustness analysis of the aviation-only network against the integrated aviation-HSR network for both Europe and China. Using a multi-layer network representation of scheduled services, topological metrics and a schedule-based routing algorithm, the networks are subjected to simulated random airport failures, adaptive targeted hub attacks, and operational airline shutdowns. The results reveal that under random failures, both unimodal aviation networks exhibit similar topological decay. However, under targeted attacks, China's reliance on a highly concentrated hub-and-spoke system leads to an earlier topological collapse compared to Europe's decentralized, point-to-point network. Crucially, integrating the HSR layer fundamentally shifts this dynamic. China's unified HSR mega-grid acts as a safeguard that nearly halves topological vulnerability and preserves substantial service availability during major aviation disruptions. Conversely, Europe's fragmented HSR ''patchwork" provides only marginal redundancy during aviation crises. While China can strategically leverage its HSR grid to mitigate disruptions in the aviation network, Europe must prioritize cross-border rail services to create a viable multimodal safety net for long-distance travel.

title: Evaluation of a GNSS-derived RTK-RISK indicator against global space-weather indices during the May 2024 geomagnetic storm
title_zh: 2024年5月地磁风暴期间全球导航卫星系统衍生的RTK-RISK指标与全球空间天气指数的评估
summary: 严重的空间天气事件会产生快速的时间和空间电离层干扰，从而降低高精度全球导航卫星系统（ GNSS ）的定位。本研究根据2024年5月11日极端地磁风暴期间独立的全球空间天气和地磁指数，对区域GNSS衍生的RTK-RISK指标进行评估。RTK-RISK结合了来自拉脱维亚连续运行参考站网络的区域总电子含量指数（ ROTI ）变异率和空间垂直总电子含量（ VTEC ）梯度。
abstract: Severe space-weather events can produce rapid temporal and spatial ionospheric disturbances that degrade high-precision Global Navigation Satellite System (GNSS) positioning. This study evaluates a regional GNSS-derived RTK-RISK indicator against independent global space-weather and geomagnetic indices during the extreme geomagnetic storm of 11 May 2024. RTK-RISK combines regional Rate of Total Electron Content Index (ROTI) variability and spatial vertical total electron content (VTEC) gradients derived from a Latvian continuously operating reference station network. The indicator and its individual components were compared with the geomagnetic Dst and Kp indices, the interplanetary magnetic field Bz component, its southward component Bs, solar-wind speed, and the coupling proxy VswBs. Spearman rank correlation was used as the principal measure of association. The strongest statistically significant simultaneous relationship with RTK-RISK was observed for Dst (ρ = −0.63). Kp showed a positive association of ρ = 0.65, although this relationship did not reach statistical significance (p = 0.078, N = 8) at its native 3-h resolution. Significant simultaneous associations were also observed for Bs (ρ = 0.41), Bz (ρ = −0.40), and VswBs (ρ = 0.35). The signs of these relationships were physically consistent with enhanced geomagnetic activity and southward interplanetary magnetic field conditions. The results indicate that the independently derived regional RTK-RISK indicator responds coherently to global space-weather conditions and provides a locally resolved measure of ionospheric disturbance relevant to RTK positioning reliability.

title: Impact of Fractal Dimension on Antenna Behavior: Sierpiński Carpet and Koch Snowflake Designs
title_zh: 文献研究：Impact of Fractal Dimension on Antenna Behavior: Sierpiński Carpet and Koch Snowflake Designs
summary: This paper presents a comparative study of two fractal antennas—the Sierpiński Carpet and Koch Snowflake-designed with identical dimensions and operating at 2.3~GHz. Although similar in size, their di…
abstract: This paper presents a comparative study of two fractal antennas—the Sierpiński Carpet and Koch Snowflake-designed with identical dimensions and operating at 2.3~GHz. Although similar in size, their different fractal geometries lead to distinct electromagnetic behaviors. Key performance metrics such as input impedance, reflection coefficient, and radiation patterns are analyzed.

title: The Lunar Stairway: An Orbital-Platform-First Paradigm for Lunar Development and Its Engineering Rationale
title_zh: 文献研究：The Lunar Stairway: An Orbital-Platform-First Paradigm for Lunar Development and Its Engineering Rationale
summary: Objective: To examine the mainstream premise that lunar development must be based on the lunar surface; to argue the engineering rationale for building long-term residential bases, production faciliti…
abstract: Objective: To examine the mainstream premise that lunar development must be based on the lunar surface; to argue the engineering rationale for building long-term residential bases, production facilities, and logistics hubs first in circumlunar orbit rather than on the lunar surface; and to propose a system design for the “Lunar Stairway” (a distributed system of circumlunar platform ports).  Methods: On the basis of orbital mechanics (the vis-viva equation and the rocket equation), the velocity increments and mass penalties of lunar-surface landing and departure were calculated and compared with those of residence in circumlunar orbit; the success rate of lunar soft-landing missions worldwide from 1966 to 2025 was tallied; scientific assessments of the Apollo moonquake network, the Chang’e-4 in situ radiation measurements on the lunar surface, and the health effects of lunar dust were compiled; and a ballistic delivery and interception–deceleration model for the “circumlunar platform–capsule projectile–cable-net/pit/sponge-lake splashdown” system was established.  Results: A one-way landing on the lunar surface requires a velocity increment of approximately 1.9 km/s (with Isp = 300 s, propellant accounts for approximately 47.6% of the initial mass), and departure from the Moon requires a further approximately 1.85 km/s. The fully successful lunar soft-landing rate is approximately 50%, with failures concentrated in the powered-descent phase. Apollo seismometers recorded shallow moonquakes of magnitude up to approximately 5, lasting from tens of minutes to several hours, far longer than the tens of seconds of terrestrial earthquakes. The dose equivalent rate on the lunar surface is approximately 1.4 mSv/d (twice that on the International Space Station), and an extreme solar particle event of the 1972 type could deliver a dose of the order of 3–4 Sv without shielding. Lunar dust is fine, electrically charged, and sharp-edged; it is difficult to remove completely and causes irreversible damage to equipment and to the human respiratory system. With frozen orbits, the annual station-keeping velocity increment in low lunar orbit can be held to 10–50 m/s, corresponding to approximately 3–17 kg/(t·yr) of chemical propellant or approximately 0.6–3.2 kg/(t·yr) with electric propulsion, comparable to or lower than the ISS reboost level (approximately 18 kg/(t·yr)); ballistic delivery requires only an ejection increment of approximately 23 m/s and approximately 10 kg/t of propellant. Near-lunar orbits, although they require more orbit control, maintain closer contact with the lunar surface and receive less galactic radiation because of blockage by the Moon. Different orbits and distributed deployments should therefore be adopted according to actual requirements.  Conclusions: Circumlunar-orbit platforms are comprehensively superior to lunar-surface residence in energy, safety, environment, astronomical observation, and logistics efficiency. It is recommended that the primary construction layer of lunar development be placed in lunar orbit rather than on the lunar surface, and that low-overload ballistic delivery and electromagnetic ejection be used to open a “lunar orbit–lunar surface” materials corridor (without which construction of the Stairway would be pointless). If a momentum-exchange mode is adopted between platform and cargo, substantial propellant and energy can be saved, coupling the efficient descent of cargo with platform orbit changes and orbit maintenance. The paper also proposes that spent spacecraft hulls be stored in lunar orbit as a reserve of scarce metals.

title: Ultrathin metal layer boosts spin-related signals, opening a door to ultralow-power electronics
title_zh: 超薄金属层增强了自旋相关信号，为超低功耗电子产品打开了大门
summary: 九州大学的研究人员发现，超薄的铱锰（IrMn）层可以改善由磁绝缘体和铂薄膜制成的结构中的两个自旋相关信号。通过研究自旋电流是如何产生和吸收的，研究小组深入了解了中间层如何改善自旋转移。这些发现可以为用于计算和能量收集的超低功耗设备的开发提供信息。
abstract: Researchers at Kyushu University have found that an ultrathin layer of iridium manganese (IrMn) can improve two spin-related signals in a structure made of a magnetic insulator and a platinum film. By examining how spin currents are generated and absorbed, the team gained insights into how the intermediate layer improves spin transfer. The findings could inform the development of ultralow-power devices for computing and energy harvesting.

title: Structural, Dielectric, Optical, and Electrochemical Insights into Enhanced OER Activity of Y3Fe5O12 over YFeO3 Ferrite Nanoparticles for Hydroelectric Cell Applications
title_zh: 文献研究：Structural, Dielectric, Optical, and Electrochemical Insights into Enhanced OER Activity of Y3Fe5O12 over YFeO3 Ferrite Nanoparticles for Hydroelectric Cell Applications
summary: YFeO3 (YF) and Y3Fe5O12 (YGF) nanoparticles were synthesized by a modified low-temperature sol-gel auto-combustion route to elucidate structure–property relationships governing oxygen evolution reacti…
abstract: YFeO3 (YF) and Y3Fe5O12 (YGF) nanoparticles were synthesized by a modified low-temperature sol-gel auto-combustion route to elucidate structure–property relationships governing oxygen evolution reaction (OER) and hydroelectric cell (HEC) performance. Rietveld-refined XRD confirmed orthorhombic YF and cubic garnet YGF phases, while Raman and HRTEM established phase purity, crystallinity, and morphology. YGF exhibited higher dielectric permittivity (23.20), lower dielectric loss (0.765), larger specific surface area (12.815 m2g− 1), and oxygen-vacancy-rich surface chemistry, facilitating electrochemical charge transfer. Accordingly, YGF showed higher ECSA (18.25 cm²), Cdl (0.73 mF cm− 2), and lower Rct (359 Ω) than YF. YGF delivered superior OER activity with an overpotential of 392 mV at 10 mA cm− 2 and a Tafel slope of 133 mV dec− 1. The YGF-based HEC achieved 14.123 mA short-circuit current, 0.981 V open-circuit voltage, and 13.854 mW maximum power, demonstrating its potential for sustainable hydroelectric energy conversion. These findings establish YGF as a promising multifunctional energy-conversion material.

title: A Physics-Informed, Corrosion-Aware Digital-Twin Framework for Condition Monitoring of Saline-Service Centrifugal Pumps
title_zh: 用于盐水离心泵状态监测的物理信息、腐蚀感知数字孪生框架
summary: 在盐水环境中工作的离心泵直接弥合与腐蚀相关的材料劣化、动态响应和水力效率领域，但状态监测方法通常将这些领域隔离开来。作者之前的一项工作引入了泵退化指数 (PDI)，将源自试样、RMS 振动和水力效率退化的与腐蚀相关的材料退化指标结合到一个状态指标中。这项工作通过提出一个基于时间、基于物理的数字孪生框架来探索将这些联系起来的潜力，其中 PDI 被用作透明的退化中间状态，而不是作为故障概率或寿命终止指示器。使用五个层：物理资产和传感；数据处理和分类；标准化退化指标；
abstract: Centrifugal pumps working in saline environments directly bridge corrosion-related material deterioration, dynamic response and hydraulic efficiency domains, yet condition-monitoring approaches often isolate these. A preceding work by the author introduced a Pump Degradation Index (PDI) by combining a corrosion-related material degradation indicator derived from coupons, RMS vibration and hydraulic-efficiency degradation into one condition indicator. This work explores the potential to link these by proposing a time-based, physics-based digital twin framework where the PDI is used as a transparent intermediate state of degradation rather than as a failure probability or end-of-life indicator. Five layers are used: physical asset and sensing; data processing and classification; normalized degradation indicators; a physics-based virtual pump; and residual-driven condition assessment and decision support. A corrosion-driven material degradation, efficiency and dynamic response state-space representation is formulated with flow, head, speed, pressure, temperature, chemistry and discharge angle as operating variables. The framework is tested in a environment based on the five-point laboratory degradation trajectory that underpins the PDI work, with pump output predictions from a reduced-order pump model and residual generation resulting from states using out-of-phase operating variables (flow, head, pressure, head, speed and temperature). The results depict the normalized component trajectories and PDI values for the five test cases of 0.000, 0.301, 0.542, 0.777 and 1.000 over 0-200 h, but do not demonstrate validation. The framework is intentionally simplistic for use in offshore sparse-data environments where a digital twin may be unrealistic. Prior to field adoption, the conditions/maintenance framework requires re-testing with multiple units, continuous field data and independently quantified component degradation, and maintenance and failure records.

title: Theoretical method uses light to locate anyons, potential quantum computing building blocks
title_zh: 理论方法使用光来定位任意子，潜在的量子计算构建块
summary: 埃默里大学的理论物理学家发现了一种方法，可以利用光来探测任何电子的“光谱指纹” --从许多电子的集体行为中产生的奇异准粒子。他们的发现发表在《物理评论快报》上。这项工作为研究任意子提供了一种新工具，它具有作为量子计算基础构建块的潜力。
abstract: Theoretical physicists at Emory University have discovered a way to use light to detect the "spectral fingerprints" of anyons—exotic quasiparticles that emerge from the collective behavior of many electrons. Their findings are published in Physical Review Letters. The work offers a new tool for the study of anyons, which hold potential as fundamental building blocks for quantum computing.
